name: Cassandra Winter
original_name: แคสแซนดร้า วินเทอร์
source: Cassie is still relatively new to the Falconers business. In facts, this is her first solo mission. She’s a crack shot, cool under pressure, and naturally untrusting, a good survival trait for Falconers. She just hasn’t personally handled a Culler investigation before. She’s assisted in several, but this is her chance to prove herself as a full-fledged hunter of Cullers.
